biography.text: Born in 1981 in Brooklyn. Semper earned a B.A. from Hampton University (2003) and a J.D. from Rutgers Law School–Newark (2007). He clerked in New Jersey Superior Court, prosecuted in Union and Essex Counties, and joined the U.S. Attorney’s Office in New Jersey in 2018, where he led violent-crime and organized-crime units and served as a deputy criminal chief. President Biden appointed him.
